title: (RHBA-2019:2391) ostree bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated ostree packages that fix one bug are now available for the Extras channel of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Workstation|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems|7|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Power, little endian|7|ppc64le
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
OSTree is a tool for managing bootable, immutable, versioned file system trees.

This update fixes the following bug:

* unable to upgrade to new commit using RHELAH 7.7 RC2; regfile copy: Inappropriate ioctl for device (BZ#1730779)

Users of ostree are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
